question: On International Women's Day 2022, the Ministry of MSME launched an entrepreneurship drive for women by which of the following names?
solution:
The correct answer is SAMARTH. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• On **International Women's Day 2022**, the **Ministry of MSME** launched an **entrepreneurship drive** for **women** under the **SAMARTH** scheme.
 
• SAMARTH stands for** Support for Augmenting MSMEs through Resource and Technology Upgradation.**
 
• It is aimed at providing** financial assistance **to MSMEs for **technology upgradation, skill development,** and other such initiatives.
 
• The scheme aims to** empower women entrepreneurs** by providing them with access to** credit, market linkages,** and other resources required for the** growth of their businesses.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Nirbhaya** is a** government scheme **aimed at ensuring the** safety and security** of women in **public spaces.**
 
• **Swadhar **is a scheme aimed at providing **shelter and rehabilitation** to women in difficult circumstances.
 
• **Ujjawala** is a scheme aimed at **preventing trafficking of women and children **for commercial sexual exploitation.
